Contraindicated [ketoconazole:contraindications:2].

Coadministration of ketoconazole with CYP3A4-metabolized HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors such as simvastatin is contraindicated [ketoconazole:contraindications:2]. Ketoconazole can potentially increase plasma concentrations of simvastatin, which elevates the risk of skeletal muscle toxicity, including myopathy and rhabdomyolysis [ketoconazole:drug_interactions:18, simvastatin:drug_interactions:2].
